cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: The COT residual that arms a weekend seam is spent by MEASURED CONSUMPTION IN THE TAPE, not by the WoW delta and not by the calendar. One publication armed the 05-29 seam correctly and must NOT arm the 06-05 seam - and the consumption that disarmed it is visible three sessions before D-1, which is why A's D-1-only window cannot see it.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.1_the_premise_i_had_half_wrong: My blind claim was 'ONE COT report backed BOTH of my seams'. Checking the staged field: at the two OPENS the live publications DIFFER (0529 open carries report 05-19 / pub 05-22, WoW +23,762 IMPROVING; 0605 open carries report 05-26 / pub 05-29 15:30, WoW -38,123 WORSENING, MM net -134,426 at the 0.94 1y-pctile). So there was no double-count on the open-time channel. But at the two CLOSES - which is where a SEAM handoff is formed - the 05-29 15:30 publication is live at BOTH (it goes live 90 minutes before the 0529 close and is still the only publication carried in state at the 0605 close). The double-count was real on the SEAM channel and imaginary on the OPEN channel, and I had not separated the two. Lesson, general: state the CHANNEL (open-time direction vs close-time seam handoff) before declaring a positioning double-count; a publication can be fresh on one and stale on the other in the same session.

2_verdict_calendar_tiebreak_vs_A_unconsu.verdict: A's UNCONSUMED-RESIDUAL test is the better instrument and it REPLACES my calendar tie-break as the sign source - but only after one correction, and my calendar term survives only as a small carry, not as a sign.
2_verdict_calendar_tiebreak_vs_A_unconsu.why_my_calendar_tiebreak_was_right_for_a: in_gsci_roll TRUE with gsci_roll_day_n 1 plus in_bcom_hedge_roll TRUE on 06-05 is real and it is decidable at the open. But an index roll's day-1 tranche is ~20% of the index NG book against 336k front OI; it is worth on the order of 50-100 USD of front-month pressure. It got the SIGN of a -1340 day right while accounting for at most ~6% of the magnitude. A tie-break that explains a fifteenth of the move is not the mechanism - it is a coin that landed the right way. DEMOTED: roll-carry is a -70 additive term in my 0605 build, not the sign instrument.
2_verdict_calendar_tiebreak_vs_A_unconsu.the_correction_A_needs: A's window - 'the D-1 post-publication phase net flow' - is too short by construction. Run it on 0605: D-1 is 06-04, phase flows -164 / -2682 / -2816, no cross to net buying at all, so A's test reports the residual STILL LOADED and would emit UP into the 06-05 seam. The 05-29 residual was in fact consumed on 06-01 (+3,796) and 06-02 (+3,524) - +7,320 of net BUYING two and three sessions before D-1, which is exactly the covering firing. The window must be ALL sessions from publication_ts to the candidate seam, not the D-1 phase.

the_corrected_instrument.name: cot_residual_consumption_window (E's correction of A's proposal; supersedes my calendar tie-break)
the_corrected_instrument.rule: A crowded-short COT publication arms an UP prior at the FIRST weekend seam after its publication_ts. It arms LATER seams ONLY IF the residual is unconsumed. Consumption = any CROSS to cumulative NET-POSITIVE signed flow in the sessions between publication_ts and the candidate seam (net buying = the covering being taken). Mere DECAY of negative flow toward zero is NOT consumption - the residual stays loaded. Once consumed, the publication is spent for every later seam and the seam reverts to the chain/state default until a NEW publication rebuilds the stack.
the_corrected_instrument.test_seam_1_0529_close: publication 05-29 15:30; sessions from publication to seam = the remainder of 0529, phase 3 sflow -59. Decayed from -1,573 to -59 but never crossed. UNCONSUMED -> LOADED -> UP seam-gap prior into 06-01. REALIZED: 0601 gap +690 UP. CORRECT.
the_corrected_instrument.test_seam_2_0605_close: same publication; sessions from publication to seam = 0601 +3,796, 0602 +3,524, 0603 -2,852, 0604 -5,662. Crossed to net buying immediately, cumulative +7,320 across the first two. CONSUMED -> no UP prior at seam 2 -> revert to chain/state default. REALIZED: no squeeze; 0605 delivered -1340 aligned-down. CORRECT.
the_corrected_instrument.what_it_falsifies: The literal reading of the incumbent positioning.covering_self_limiting_cot_wow_gate - 'Worsening WoW = covering LIVE and RECURRING -> size full, RE-FIRES at the next seam' - is falsified here. The WoW was -38,123 (worsening) and unchanged in state across both seams, so the WoW gate re-fires covering-UP at seam 2 and is WRONG by 1340. The WoW delta says the fuel EXISTED; only the tape says whether it has been BURNED. Proposed patch (not applied - no brain edits in this run): the WoW gate governs whether a residual was ever created; the consumption window governs whether it is still there.

2_verdict_calendar_tiebreak_vs_A_unconsu.how_they_compose_not_compete: The residual test and the extension/absorption test answer DIFFERENT questions and the 05-29 seam proves it. The residual test governs the SEAM GAP (loaded -> +690 UP, right). structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip governs the SESSION (cum_from_anchor +2390, chain age 5, and 0601 ph2 showed +1,892 BUY flow absorbed under -2,030 of price = the absorption tell REVERSED = distribution DOWN, right). B's blind called 0601 +350 against -990 because it read the loaded-seam UP prior as a DAY sign instead of a GAP sign. Gap-first allocation, exactly as boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot already specifies, is the fix - and it is my handoff_out's job to hand B both halves separately.

handoff_out.exit_type: FLOWLESS_BID_WITHDRAWAL - a fifth type, not one of the four in daytype.friday_exit_decomposition. The final phase moved price -810 on a net signed flow of -59, i.e. essentially BALANCED. This is not CREST_TRIM (needs same-side squaring flow), not POSITIONING_SPENT (needs price moving against last-hour flow with flow present), not MOMENTUM_CARRY (needs aligned flow), and not FUNDAMENTAL_CARRY. Nobody sold this low. The covering bid simply went home into the weekend and price fell through air. GENERAL MECHANISM: a price displacement made without flow is owned by nobody and reverts at the next liquidity restoration - a Friday close whose final phase is flowless is a FAKE CLOSE and must not be handed on as a level.
handoff_out.monday_bias: TWO-PART, GAP-FIRST - do not collapse these into one day sign. (1) SEAM GAP: UP, sized at 70-85% of the flowless final-phase drop, i.e. +570 to +690. Two independent channels agree: the flowless -810 reverts, AND the 05-29 15:30 COT publication (MM net -134,426, 1y pctile 0.94, WoW -38,123 worsening) is UNCONSUMED at this seam - post-publication flow decayed (-1,573 -> -59) without ever crossing to net buying, so the covering is loaded and unfired. (2) INTRADAY: DOWN, and potentially LARGE. Extension is maximal (cum_from_anchor +2,390 on a 3.034 anchor, chain age 5), which is the exact configuration in which structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip says the identical absorption signature inverts. WATCH FOR THE TRIGGER: if the Monday's main US phase prints heavy BUY flow absorbed under a FALLING price, that is the distribution flip - the late chasers from the +2,710 covering ramp are being distributed to, and the day is a large DOWN of order -1,000 to -1,700, not a gap-and-hold. Do NOT read the loaded seam as a day sign; it is a gap sign.
handoff_out.close_location_in_range: AT the session low (lo_et 16:59:20, close = the low, high_exc +990 / low_exc -170 relative to the open, turn_mag 1,150 off the 08:51 high). BUT daytype.friday_exit_close_location_over_flow_shape MUST STAND DOWN here and I am flagging the condition it is missing: that play takes the verdict from close location rather than flow-shape decay, and it was calibrated on flow-BACKED closes. A close-on-low made on -59 of net flow is an unpriced print, not a defended level. PROPOSED CONDITION (not applied - no brain edits this run): the close-location rule requires the final phase to carry material net flow; below that it inverts, because a flowless extreme reverts rather than continues.
handoff_out.final_phase_conviction: UNDEFINED / NEAR-ZERO, not negative and not positive. flow_conviction = sign(-59) * sign(-810) = +1 nominally ALIGNED, but on a flow magnitude of 59 against phase-2's 1,573 the sign is noise. Report it as NO CONVICTION and let the gap prior carry the seam. Note for the record: phase 2 of this session was still absorbing (sflow -1,573, pxchg +530, ph_absorb TRUE) - the covering bid worked all morning and quit in the afternoon.

The publication in state (report 05-26, pub 05-29 15:30, MM net -134,426, 1y pctile 0.94, WoW -38,123 WORSENING) is BACKWARD-LOOKING: it measures the short base as of 05-26, one session BEFORE the 0527/0528 squeeze began. By the 0605 open that base has been run over for seven sessions, and the consumption is MEASURED not asserted - 0601 +3,796 and 0602 +3,524 = +7,320 of cumulative NET BUYING after the publication. Absorption capacity is FINITE - it is bounded by the size of the short base that must cover - and per-unit productivity has collapsed (0528: -1,966 flow bought +2,090; 0604: -5,662 bought +1,140, a ~5x deterioration in price per unit of absorbed flow).
turn_exhaustion_gate.verdict: GATE FIRES DOWN, and unlike 0529 it fires on a BROKEN bid, not a saturated one. The covering-UP prior is dead on BOTH channels (residual consumed AND absorption productivity collapsed). GENERAL MECHANISM, stated so it can be falsified: absorption capacity is finite and bounded by the covering short base; when absorbed sell flow accumulates across consecutive sessions while price-per-unit-of-absorbed-flow deteriorates, the covering bid is being exhausted, and the session after exhaustion prices the accumulated unrewarded sell pressure in one aligned move. This generalizes to any absorbed-flow regime in either polarity - it is not a 0605 story.
